title: AI potential as economic growth source among Marcos' agenda in APEC
summary: Malacañang said the potential of artificial intelligence (AI) as a driver of economic growth is on President Ferdinand Marcos Jr."s agenda at this year"s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC)…

blocks.text: Malacañang said the potential of artificial intelligence (AI) as a driver of economic growth is on President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s agenda at this year’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders’ Meeting in China.

In an interview with Balitanghali on Thursday, Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro said the Philippines aims to deepen its engagement in AI and ensure the country does not fall behind in its evolving technology.

“Isa talaga sa target ng Pangulo ay magkaroon ng paglago sa ekonomiya ng bansa. Kailangan natin maipakita kung ano ang kakayahan ng Pilipinas, kung maaari silang, paano silang dapat dito rin mag-invest sa Pilipinas,” Castro said.
(One of the President’s main targets is to generate economic growth for the country. We need to showcase what the Philippines is capable of and demonstrate how and why they should invest here.)
“At ang isa sa mga tinututukan ng Pangulo dito ay 'yung technological change, particularly 'yung AI as a new source of growth,” she added.
(One of the key areas the President is focusing on is technological change, particularly AI as a new source of growth.)
Aside from technology and investments, the Palace said Marcos will also focus on agriculture, education, and trade during his meetings.
Marcos arrived in China on Wednesday to participate in the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting.
The meetings will run from November 18 to 19, following the annual APEC CEO Summit held from November 17 to 18.
Also present at the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting are US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin.—LDF, GMA News
